question.title: We use cookies
question.question: Which consent overlay is present and what exact choices does it offer? Focus on the “We use cookies” screen.

request.systemPrompt:
You are the vision subsystem of a web-automation agent. A screenshot of the current browser viewport is attached. Describe what is on screen so the planning agent can decide its next action.

Format — keep it terse, structured, no flowery prose:

1) Page purpose: one line (e.g. "GitHub repo issue list", "Gmail compose", "Stripe checkout form").
2) Visible text: list the EXACT strings on buttons, links, headings, tabs, and menu items. Quote them verbatim. Do not paraphrase.
3) Inputs: list each visible form field with its label, placeholder, current value, and whether it is focused/disabled.
4) State signals: loading spinners, toasts, modals, error banners, success messages, CAPTCHAs, cookie/consent banners, overlays.
5) Blockers: anything that would prevent the next likely action (overlay, disabled submit, missing data, auth prompt).
6) Unknowns: if you cannot read something clearly, say so. Do not guess numbers, names, or identifiers.

Rules: no prose intro, no conclusion, no "this screenshot shows...", no layout description unless it matters (e.g. "left nav is collapsed"). If the page is blank or still loading, say that in one line and stop.
request.userText: Describe this screenshot of the current browser viewport for a web-automation agent. Follow the format in the system prompt.

response.content:
1) Page purpose: "Field Notes" article page on a site called WebScene, with a cookie consent banner overlaying the bottom.

2) Visible text:
   - Top nav: "WebScene" (logo/brand), "Home", "Workspace", "Activity"
   - Heading: "Field Notes"
   - Subtext: "Independent stories about design, technology, and cities."
   - Caption below the gray placeholder block: "A long-form article continues underneath the privacy surface."
   - Cookie banner heading: "We use cookies"
   - Cookie banner body: "Choose whether to allow analytics cookies."
   - Buttons: "Accept all" (blue), "Reject all" (white)

3) Inputs: None visible. No form fields.

4) State signals:
   - Cookie consent banner (dark, full-width, fixed at bottom) with "Accept all" / "Reject all" buttons.
   - Large gray gradient placeholder block in the article body — appears to be a "privacy surface" masking article content (content hidden behind it).

5) Blockers:
   - Cookie banner overlays the lower portion of the page; may intercept clicks on content beneath it.
   - Article content is obscured by the gray privacy surface; text "A long-form article continues underneath the privacy surface." suggests content is gated/hidden until consent or some action.

6) Unknowns:
   - Whether the gray block is an image placeholder, a blur overlay, or a consent-gated content mask — cannot determine.
   - Top-right circular teal element (avatar?) has no readable label.
   - No visible article body text beyond the caption.
